name: The Lake Como EDITION
insider_take: Lake Como's newest luxury arrival brings EDITION's signature modern sophistication to one of Italy's most legendary destinations, where Hollywood royalty and European aristocracy have retreated for centuries.
whats_special: This is the first EDITION property in Italy, featuring Ian Schrager's iconic design philosophy against the backdrop of the Alps. The hotel sits on the shores where Villa del Balbianello (famous from James Bond's Casino Royale) is just a boat ride away, and guests can access the same pristine waters that have captivated visitors since Roman times.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on the upper floors – the morning light hitting the Grigne mountains creates the perfect golden hour that lasts well into the afternoon, and you'll understand why this view inspired countless artists and writers.
dont_miss: Take the hotel's private boat to explore the lake's hidden grottos and visit Villa Monastero's botanical gardens in nearby Varenna. The lake's unique microclimate supports Mediterranean flora at an Alpine latitude – a geographical marvel that creates some of Europe's most stunning natural scenery.
pros: Stunning lakefront location on iconic Lake Como
Access to Marriott STARS program benefits
cons: Limited availability due to exclusive nature
